Theorem rows: ledger/theorems.jsonl:7,8,11,14,15,16,24,25,28,31,32,34,36,38,39,41,43,45,47,48,50,51,52,53,55,56,58,59,61,62. HF-02 class_leakage via disjunction (critical, evaluation_rubric.yaml:52-54 and 176-179): 8 rows bind two frozen classes in one class_ids list: ledger/theorems.jsonl:4 (D-004), :5 (D-005), :25 (T-303), :27 (T-305), :30 (T-402), :46 (T-515), :58 (T-526), :60 (T-528). A0:54 says classes 'must never be disjoined in a statement'. Control run: research_map/class_separation.py#c266dbceca87 returns 0 findings on the raw ledger text (findings_for_text cannot parse JSONL rows) and flags only T-402.regularity when rows are parsed one by one; _scan_class_ids (:97-114) never flags a list of two distinct known tokens. So FREEZE-REV2's 'class separation exit 0' line is not evidence about this ledger; the disjunctions are machine-invisible to the project detector. flash-22 reads the same 8 rows as coverage annotation; the rubric text controls for a gate.

HF-03 unsupported_citation / class-metadata mismatch (critical, evaluation_rubric.yaml:182-186): ledger/theorems.jsonl:4 (D-004) binds AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN and AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN to SRC-029, whose primary abstract I re-fetched at https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.08975: the matter model is Einstein-Maxwell-scalar and Lambda > 0, while both bound classes forbid matter_model != vacuum and cosmological_constant != 0 (evaluation_rubric.yaml:69-102). The ledger row schema has no transfer_argument field anywhere (key census), so no transfer is recorded. Same family, weaker: :2 (D-002) cites charged/scalar sources, :3 (D-003) cites a charged-scalar source, :46 (T-515) cites Kerr-de Sitter sources, and the 7 informs_classes rows (:26,:28,:31,:35,:36,:40,:41) point non-vacuum results at vacuum classes with no transfer note. Cause: 0/97 sources carry scope metadata, so this defect class is undetectable by the frozen tooling.
